question: Ustad Zakir Hussain plays which of the following instruments?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tabla**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Ustad Zakir Hussain:-**

 
 
• **He is a renowned Indian tabla player, composer, percussionist, music producer, and film actor. **
 
• He is the eldest son of tabla player Alla Rakha.
 
• **Hussain is considered to be one of the greatest tabla players of all time, and is known for his virtuosic playing, improvisational skills, and innovative approach to music.**
 
• Hussain has collaborated with a wide range of musicians from around the world, including John McLaughlin, Yo-Yo Ma, and Mickey Hart. He has also composed music for films and television shows.
 
• **Hussain is a recipient of numerous awards and honors, including the Padma Shri, Padma Bhushan, and Padma Vibhushan, the highest civilian honors awarded by the Government of India.**
